bull.b: Strong sales growth combined with high gross margins indicates attractive product economics and increasing commercial traction. If sustained, this mix can provide the contribution needed to absorb operating investments, support cash generation, and improve earnings potential over the next several quarters.

VEVYE is demonstrating durable adoption through rising prescriptions, a broader prescriber base, and expanding branded share. Growth across this franchise, alongside demand for IHEEZO and TRIESENCE, gives Harrow multiple commercial drivers rather than reliance on a single product.

The completed TYRVAYA acquisition broadens Harrow’s dry-eye offering and adds an established commercial asset to its existing infrastructure. The added product and personnel could deepen physician coverage, improve portfolio breadth, and create a meaningful revenue contributor beyond the current product base.

bear.b: A more debt-funded balance sheet reduces financial flexibility if operating performance weakens and increases the importance of sustained cash generation. Higher leverage can also constrain capital allocation, raise refinancing exposure, and make future growth investments more dependent on execution.

Widening losses show that strong product-level economics have not yet translated into consistent company-wide profitability. Elevated operating or non-operating costs may continue to absorb gross profit, limiting retained cash, reducing resilience, and making the path to durable earnings more execution-sensitive.

Meeting the reiterated annual outlook requires a substantial acceleration in the second half, placing significant dependence on channel normalization, VEVYE growth, salesforce productivity, and TYRVAYA integration. Any delay across these initiatives could weaken revenue delivery and postpone operating leverage.
